x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
best = 2e9
target = x / y
best_num = best_den = tmp = 0
i = 1

while i <= n:
    a = int(target * i + 0.4999)
    tmp = abs(a / i - target)
    if tmp < best:
        best = tmp
        best_num = a
        best_den = i
    i += 1

print(f"{int(best_num)}/{int(best_den)}")
